title: Building a graph
description:
Read edges into an adjacency list and describe the graph.

```
edges: A-B A-C B-C C-D
A: B C      (degree 2)
B: A C      (degree 2)
C: A B D    (degree 3)
D: C        (degree 1)
4 nodes, 4 edges
```
requirements: `std::map<char, std::vector<char>>` as the adjacency list; edges go both ways.
Print each node's neighbours sorted and its degree.
Check that the sum of degrees is twice the number of edges.
stretch: Store the same graph as an adjacency matrix and compare the memory used.
